subject: Post-call: integration checklist + validation playbook for ELogiSys pilot
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <etorres@elogisys.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: integration checklist + validation playbook for ELogiSys pilot

Hi Elena — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align engineering and get you into a short pilot: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Ingest product catalog updates as embeddings for similarity search and reranking (daily incremental).
- Serve structured shipping-estimate responses from the LLM (JSON tool-calling style) for our quoting UI.
- Strong schema guarantees: your legal & ops teams need near-deterministic JSON fields for downstream systems (carrier_id, est_days, price_cents).
- Multi-tenant isolation: pilot should run in a dedicated environment with RBAC and audit logs.

Quick technical approach (high level)
- SDK + auth: we recommend using Redwood JS SDK v0.9 (server-side only) with short-lived tokens + KMS-backed service key for pilot. Token rotation handled by our token-refresh middleware.
- Routing: route production-low-cost path to a quantized variant for routine lookups; route high-accuracy quoting requests to the higher-precision model. Policy will be request-tag driven.
- Structured output reliability: enforce a JSON schema in two layers — constrained decoding (decoder preference and token-level filters) and post-generation validation with automated retries/fallback parsing.
- Embeddings / reranker: index daily with our incremental embed pipeline; use a lightweight reranker model for final sort before quoting.

Attachments: pilot-checklist.xlsx (milestones + success metrics), arch-diagram.png (proposed network flow).

Next steps
1) Please confirm the initial dataset cadence (daily vs hourly) and whether PII needs redaction before embedding.
2) I'll set up a shared pilot folder and a sandbox API key scoped to your environment; need a contact for your infra person who can accept the RSA KMS config.
3) Can Marissa or Laura sync with your engineering lead next Tue for a 30-min architecture alignment?

Action items assigned
- Sergio: provision sandbox key + pilot folder (ETA: 48 hours)
- Marissa: prepare abbreviated SDK quickstart with auth snippet and routing examples
- Laura: draft validation playbook with retry/backoff recommendations for structured outputs

Thanks — happy to iterate.

— Sergio

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Clement Ng <clement.ng@elogisys.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <etorres@elogisys.co>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: integration checklist + validation playbook for ELogiSys pilot

Forwarding with Clement included. Team — Clement will handle KMS + peering. Two technical asks from legal that need concrete guidance:

1) "price_cents" must be an integer; "est_days" must be non-negative integer. Legal also wants a structured error code when the model returns something malformed.
2) We need a recommended validation + retry approach that minimizes user impact when the model fails the schema check.

Marissa: can you draft the SDK snippet that shows token refresh + request tagging (route=quote/high_accuracy) and include an example of how to call constrained decoding?
Laura: can you draft the validation playbook (examples below) that we can send to Elena and Clement before Tue 11am?

Suggested validation playbook outline (short) - Pre-send: attach schema and required types to the request metadata
- Constrained decoding: limit token set for object keys and use model-supplied function-calling when available
- Post-validate: JSON schema validation on response; if validation fails:
   a) Attempt 2 automated recovery attempts with prompt repair (1st: soft-guidance, 2nd: stronger directive with example)
   b) If still invalid, fall back to structured heuristic parser that maps recognized tokens into fields and tags response with error_code: SCHEMA_PARTIAL
   c) Surface to UI with graceful degradation and a clear error_code + link to re-run
- Retry/backoff: exponential backoff for automated retries with jitter; cap at 3 attempts total

We should also propose metrics to track: schema_pass_rate, avg_retries_per_request, post-retry_success_rate, time_to_first_valid_response.

Thanks — Sergio

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Clement Ng <clement.ng@elogisys.co>
Cc: Elena Torres <etorres@elogisys.co>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: integration checklist + validation playbook for ELogiSys pilot

Attached is a concise validation playbook (in the Drive link). Key recommendations summarized here: 

1) Strict schema enforcement with graded fallback
- Immediate hard validation on the server: use JSON Schema draft-07 with the following critical checks: price_cents type=integer, minimum=0; est_days type=integer, minimum=0.

2) Two-pass automated repair before user-visible failure
- Repair #1 (soft): short corrective prompt asking the model to re-format the response with explicit schema and an example. If success -> mark as auto_repaired
- Repair #2 (directive): preface request with a system instruction that enforces types and to return only valid JSON; include a minimal example that matches ELogiSys fields.

3) Heuristic fallback and error codes
- If both repairs fail, run a heuristics extractor that pulls numeric tokens and maps to nearest fields. Return partial response with error_code: SCHEMA_PARTIAL and attach confidence score.

4) Retry/backoff policy
- Attempt up to 3 total model generation calls (original + 2 repairs) with exponential backoff starting at 300ms, multiplier 2, plus 100-300ms jitter. Track attempts in headers for observability.

5) Observability + alerts
- Dashboards: schema_pass_rate, repair_success_rate, avg_latency_for_valid_response, partial_error_rate. Alert if schema_pass_rate < 98% for 24h or partial_error_rate > 1% for critical routes.

6) UX guidance
- When error_code present, surface an actionable CTA: "Retry quote" and log the event to analytics with the error_code. Provide link to re-run with human-in-the-loop if needed.

I'll finalize the playbook doc and upload an annotated example of the repair prompts. If this looks good, I can prepare the short SOW snippet for the pilot (scoped to 6 weeks) that includes these acceptance criteria.

—Laura
